decision.observation: Farmer stands on the brick road at a junction at 10:30 pm; a small house with a lamppost beside it is to the lower-left, and bushes fill the south-east.
decision.hypothesis: Following the road west along the house leads back toward the bus stop road and the farm; reaching home before 2:00 am avoids another pass-out.
decision.memory: Home route: town → west road → bus stop corridor → farm north gap → farmhouse. Introductions 7/28; 450g; half energy.
